rv.q: There's something weird, beautiful and disturbing about this Arcati, a lovable gorgon who's gone way beyond mere eccentricity.
Overall this is a wispy ectoplasm of the 1941. Noel Coward ghost comedy rather than a full-bodied materialization.
The veteran actress' portrayal of the endearing oddball medium who has unwittingly succeeded in bringing someone back from the dead was applauded at every exit and entrance.
Dame Angela is an absolute pro.

cn.t: Angela Lansbury's triumphant West End return after 40 years earns raves for her vivacious, Tony-winning turn as eccentric medium Madame Arcati in this classy Coward revival.
